title: About - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: About - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: Lady Irwin College is a constituent college of the University of Delhi located in Delhi. The college offers contact information, quick links for students, and details about its operating hours from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm. It holds an A+ accreditation from NAAC and is ranked 31st in the NIRF rankings. The college provides admission enquiry services and is powered by WhiteCode.
key_points: Lady Irwin College is part of the University of Delhi and is situated in Delhi.
The college provides contact details and quick links specifically for students.
Operating hours for the college are from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm.
The college has received an A+ accreditation from NAAC.
It is ranked 31st in the NIRF rankings.
Admission enquiries can be made through the college's contact channels.
